description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the Search service within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods to access various configuration sections such as delete, deletion, updater, and stream configurations, as well as an enum for known config path expressions and their defaults.

classes.name: SearchConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration methods for the Search service, extending multiple configuration-related interfaces, and containing an enum for known configuration path expressions with default values.

methods.name: getMongoHintsByNamespace
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the MongoDB hints by namespace if configured.

methods.name: getDeleteConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration settings for delete operations.

methods.name: getDeletionConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration settings for physical deletion of marked entity.

methods.name: getUpdaterConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration settings for search updating functionality.

methods.name: getStreamConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration settings related to streaming.
